name: Shardpunk 2
description:
About This Game

Shardpunk 2 blends turn-based tactical combat with outpost management. Undertake missions into the ruins, expand and reinforce your base, allocate scarce resources and interact with the Motherland.

XCOM tension meeets Darkest Dungeon pressure

The sacrifice of humanity’s greatest metropolis - the Capitol - to destroy the largest rat swarm changed the course of the war. Its ruins - sealed off since the cataclysm and filled with deadly secrets and precious resources - are now the focus of relentless expeditions launched by the Motherland, the rising power born from the Empire’s scattered remnants.

Plan like a commander, survive like a scavenger

As commander of a forward outpost, you scour the collapsed avenues and haunted plazas of the Capitol, searching for fusion cores, rare crystals and amber — a resin whose newly-discovered properties may yet reshape the future of humanity.

There are no safe turns, and no easy choices

The rat horde was slowed, not stopped. Their numbers have dwindled, but the survivors are smarter and deadlier than before. And patrols are now returning with reports of something else lurking in the ruins - lifeforms unknown.

Outpost Management

Dispatch teams to gather resources, fulfill Motherland directives, and barter for the assets needed to expand your base, upgrade your infrastructure and keep your troops alive.

Tactical Battlefield

Deploy hardened veterans, exploit their skills, traits and weapon proficiencies and outthink enemies both old and new in high-stakes turn-based combat.

Post-Apocalyptic Setting

This time, the apocalypse was our doing. Now the world stands on the edge of a New Dawn - one that may break humanity. Or remake it.

KEY FEATURES

  • XCOM-style tactical combat meets Darkest Dungeon-style pressure

  • Chunky, lush pixel-art rendition of a post-apocalyptic world

  • A deep roster of soldiers with multiple classes, hundreds of skills, wide equipment variety and evolving squad relationships

  • New, amber-based technology introduces new abilities and possibilities alongside existing shard-powered gear

  • A desperate race to scavenge the Capitol, unlock upgrades and craft the equipment needed to survive what comes next

Co-financed by the Minister of Culture and National Heritage under the Polish Creative Industries Institute own programme: "Program Wsparcia Gier Wideo"
short_desc: The Empire may have fallen, but humanity continues the fight. Shardpunk 2 puts you in command of a human outpost in this potent mix of turn-based tactical strategy, RPG, survival and resource management as you gather your team, scavenge for resources and prepare for a new, evolving threat.
